correctness.rationale: Pathwise matrix signs yield the exact min-adjacent-product cutoff; Dirichlet normalized exponentials reduce the random threshold to min one-dependent exponential products. A p(t)=t log(1/t)+O(t) expansion and adjacent joint upper bound 2t justify the independent-block Poisson limit. Slutsky gives factor 2, and negative Dirichlet moments give sharp q<1. Fractional exact-rational tests pass 800 cases; Monte Carlo is not proof.

value.rationale: Unrestricted iid random knots change the typical sharp explicit positive timestep from n^-2 to (n^3 log n)^-1, with exact limiting law and infinite mean reciprocal work budget. This is a concrete mathematical and algorithmic boundary between unregularized random meshes and shape-regular perturbations; it is not mere rearrangement of deterministic CFL formulas.
